name: Airbus
summary: European multinational aerospace pioneer designing, manufacturing, and servicing commercial aircraft, helicopters, defense systems, and space payloads.
internshipNotes: Offers structured Global Graduate Programs, VIE international assignments across European production plants, and university research thesis partnerships.

name: BMW Group
summary: Bavarian premium automotive and motorcycle manufacturer advancing software-defined vehicle architectures, high-voltage battery production, and circular vehicle design.
products: BMW i4 and iX Electric Sedans and SAVs
internshipNotes: Extensive Fastlane student programs, Masterarbeit (Master's thesis) contracts within R&D centers, and international SPEED trainee tracks.

name: ASML

name: LVMH Moët Hennessy Louis Vuitton
